# Cestee

> > Comprehensive airport guides covering transport, terminals, hotels, and services at airports across Europe, Asia, and beyond.

Cestee provides detailed, experience-based airport guides helping travelers navigate ground transport (buses, taxis, Uber, Bolt), terminal connections, nearby hotels, and airport amenities. Coverage spans major hubs and regional airports with practical information on airlines like Ryanair, Wizz Air, and easyJet.

## Key Topics

- Airport transport and transfers
- Public transport to city centers
- Terminal connections and layovers
- Airport hotels and sleeping
- Flight tracking (Flightradar24)
- Budget airlines (Ryanair, Wizz Air, easyJet)
- Ride-hailing services (Uber, Bolt)
- Airport WiFi and services
- Bus routes and schedules
- Car rental options
- Airport dining and amenities
- Luggage storage facilities
- Real-time flight arrivals and departures
- European regional airports
- Travel connectivity solutions

- [Getting from Sofie SOF Airport: What I Recommend](https://www.cestee.com/airport/sofia-sof/transport): Sofia SOF transport: Metro M4, buses from Terminal 1 & 2 to city
- [Getting from Brno BRQ Airport: What I Recommend](https://www.cestee.com/airport/brno-brq/transport): Transport options from Brno BRQ Airport to city via DPMB buses & taxis
- [Getting from Baku GYD Airport: What I Recommend](https://www.cestee.com/airport/baku-gyd/transport): Baku GYD transport: AeroExpress bus, BakiKart, Bolt taxis to city
- [Getting from Klagenfurt KLU Airport: What I Recommend](https://www.cestee.com/airport/klagenfurt-klu/transport): Klagenfurt KLU transport: Airport bus to Hbf, taxis, car rental options
